=== about
A stop in the middle of a code fence: the final outer patch has what was written, the fence closed, data-ypy-answer stopped and the stop text; a second stop writes nothing.
=== page
<div id="chat"></div>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #chat
data: elements <article id="a1" ypy-untrusted aria-live="off" aria-busy="true"><div id="a1-done"></div><div id="a1-tail"></div></article>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #a1-done
data: elements <p>Intro</p>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode inner
data: selector #a1-tail
data: elements <pre><code class="language-go">x := 1</code></pre>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: selector #a1
data: elements <article id="a1" ypy-untrusted aria-live="off" data-ypy-answer="stopped"><p>Intro</p><pre><code class="language-go">x := 1</code></pre><p class="ypy-model-note">Stopped.</p></article>

=== dom
<div id="chat"><article id="a1" ypy-untrusted="" aria-live="off" data-ypy-answer="stopped"><p>Intro</p><pre><code class="language-go">x := 1</code></pre><p class="ypy-model-note">Stopped.</p></article></div>
